  [inst_1 : MeasureSpace Ω₀₂] [inst_2 : IsProbabilityMeasure ℙ] [inst_3 : IsProbabilityMeasure ℙ] {G : Type uG}
  [inst_4 : AddCommGroup G] [inst_5 : Fintype G] [inst_6 : MeasurableSpace G] (p : refPackage Ω₀₁ Ω₀₂ G)
  [inst_7 : MeasurableSingletonClass G] :
  let _i := ⊥;
  ∀ (this : DiscreteTopology G),
    CompactSpace (ProbabilityMeasure G × ProbabilityMeasure G) →
      let T := fun x =>
        match x with
        | (μ₁, μ₂) => τ[id ; ↑μ₁ # id ; ↑μ₂ | p];
      Continuous T →
        ∃ μ,
          IsProbabilityMeasure μ.1 ∧
            IsProbabilityMeasure μ.2 ∧
              ∀ (ν₁ ν₂ : Measure G),
